next.reason: 1985: "Its content, when represented in standard data format, must be one or more alphabetic characters."; 2023: "Each symbol 'A' represents a character position that shall contain any character from the computer's alphanumeric character set.". Both still limit the picture string to 'A'. 2023 drops the rule that the content be alphabetic: an 'A' position may hold any alphanumeric character, and is checked only by VALIDATE.
